question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, how far in advance of scheme launch must an AIF file its PPM with SEBI through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker?

answer.text: At least 7 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 30 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 15 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 60 days prior to launch of scheme

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 13.5, as per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the Investment Manager or Sponsor must launch AIF schemes after filing the PPM with SEBI, through a SEBI registered Merchant Banker, at least 30 days prior to launch of scheme, along with payment of scheme fee. **The Trap:** 7/15 days are confusing distractors for shorter reg windows. 60 days is for listing disclosures in some ICDR contexts. For AIF PPM filing, 30 days is the rule. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A and XIX-B recall this; XIX-C requires knowing that LVFs are exempt from merchant banker filing (intimation-only model). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Build a 45–60 day buffer into your launch calendar — SEBI observations often require a revised PPM and a second merchant banker certificate, which can extend timelines.
